svg.title: The paper trail beyond the judgment
svg.desc: Source-derived archival research timeline of collection item descriptions, not reproductions or confirmations of the newspaper articles: 1984 bill and legislation coverage, 1987 return notice, 1988 175 dollar fee dispute headline, 2000 settlement headline. The university finding aid lists the material; the clippings have not been inspected. Final Vestige Studios original artwork, November 15, 2026.
